resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, GPAW)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT package capable of spin-polarised periodic calculations with van der Waals corrections and the computational hydrogen electrode model. The agent may choose the code; gold tolerances account for code/pseudopotential variations.
